title: Index Page Refactor, Scroll Geometry Correction, and Architecture Manifest Integration

commits.body: Resolved the broken scroll-spy navigation bug by refactoring coordinate tracking from relative parent offsetTop calculations to absolute document layout dimensions using getBoundingClientRect() aggregated with window.scrollY.

Fixed navigation intersection targeting exceptions by repositioning the home ID anchor string directly onto the hero section element block, ensuring immediate viewport recognition upon page initialization.
Integrated Google Fonts preconnect and style asset delivery networks in the head element to load Inter typography configurations natively across client systems.
Introduced a static manifest-container layout component into the top-of-fold view to cleanly outline the infrastructure parameters and core development runtime environments.

Overhauled the hero-section layout template from a single text block wrapper into a highly responsive two-column grid structure utilizing clamp typography controls and strict element separation rules.
Refactored the core smooth scrolling scripts to explicitly bind target query arrays across defined system containers, standardizing animation calculations throughout the scrolling sequence.
